# KIT - druggability 
## Druggability (DGIdb / Open Targets) 
 
Categories: Cell Surface, Clinically Actionable, Drug Resistance, Druggable Genome, External Side Of Plasma Membrane, Kinase, Transcription Factor, Tyrosine Kinase 
### OpenTargets tractability 
 
| Modality | Tractable | Evidence | 
|---|---|---| 
| small molecule | yes | Approved Drug, Structure with Ligand, High-Quality Ligand, High-Quality Pocket, Druggable Family | 
| antibody | yes | Phase 1 Clinical, GO CC high conf, UniProt loc med conf, UniProt SigP or TMHMM, Human Protein Atlas loc | 
| PROTAC | yes | Literature, UniProt Ubiquitination, Database Ubiquitination, Half-life Data, Small Molecule Binder | 
| other modality | no | - | 
### OpenTargets safety liabilities 
 
| Event | Datasource | Effect | Biosample | 
|---|---|---|---| 
| Anaemia | Brennan et al. (2024) | Inhibition/Decrease/Downregulation | blood | 
| Carcinogenicity | Brennan et al. (2024) | Activation/Increase/Upregulation | - | 
| cardiac disorder | Brennan et al. (2024) | Inhibition/Decrease/Downregulation | CV | 
| haematotoxicity | Brennan et al. (2024) | Inhibition/Decrease/Downregulation | blood | 
| heart disease | Force et al. (2011) | - | cardiovascular system | 
| mastocytosis | Brennan et al. (2024) | Activation/Increase/Upregulation | - | 
| neovascularization | Brennan et al. (2024) | Activation/Increase/Upregulation | - |
